surface: Hosted Profile acceptance and interrupted-run restoration
auth_mode: admin and member with existing Profile
title: Hosted Profile adapter cannot safely recover existing-row mutations after VM termination
reproduction: Inspect ee2374f3 hosted Profile route and run its four source guards; they pass.
The admin driver requires a private approved-organization fixture that the workflow does not stage.

The existing-row full baseline and write-intent receipt are fsynced only on the disposable hosted VM, excluded from uploaded artifacts. Termination after a write would lose that recovery record. No hosted Profile mutation was attempted.
expected: Before authenticated Profile writes, validate approved organization and preserve exact original state and durable write intent beyond loss of the hosted VM; retain secret/profile privacy and conditional restoration checks.
actual: Independent source peer daf00ee8 found both gaps. Profile execution is held; implementation is adding fixture staging and a fail-closed preflight while durable external recovery remains unresolved. No product failure or native restoration pass is claimed.
severity: S2: hosted testing could strand test-account edits after interruption
priority: P1: prerequisite for safely testing existing Profile remotely

transition_history.reason: Fresh independent source review found hosted fixture and interruption-recovery gaps.
Source establishes missing fixture staging and VM-local-only recovery state; no native mutation used to reproduce this unsafe condition.
Repair source preflight to refuse all hosted Profile writes until restoration is durably recoverable; full native acceptance remains required.

closure_requirement: Independent source guard and actual hosted interruption recovery with exact original data preserved, plus approved organization fixture and surrounding Profile acceptance. Refusal alone does not establish supported hosted Profile testing.
